mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases are not followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 55% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO MoM and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1), it signals overconsumption and potential economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contractionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
